run_extract_audio_samples: run the CLI to extract audio samples from H5 datasets and save them as WAV files
run_decode_mu_law_audio: run the script to decode mu-law encoded audio data from an H5 dataset into WAV format
run_load_dataset_from_args: run the tool to load dataset paths from a saved args.pth file and extract samples
run_save_wav_samples: run the module to save N decoded audio samples to an output directory as WAV files
run_extract_test_dataset_samples: run the script to extract samples from test subdirectories of multiple dataset paths
